params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: selection
params.description: Entity selection object (matching the list box's dataclass) or collection/subcollection of objects/values identifying the rows to select.

params.name: action
params.description: Selection action to apply when a row/break selection already exists.

sentinelValues.meaning: lk replace selection (default): the new selection replaces the existing selection, like a user click (no On Clicked event fired).
lk add to selection: adds to the existing selection.
lk remove from selection: removes from the existing selection.

overloads.semanticRole: Selects the rows of an entity-selection or collection list box that correspond to the given entities/objects.

constraints: selection must match the list box's kind: an entity selection of the same dataclass for an entity-selection list box, or a (sub)collection of the list box's element type for a collection list box; otherwise an error is returned.
Passing an empty selection with the default/replace action deselects all rows; with other actions it does nothing.
Entities/elements in selection that aren't displayed in the list box are ignored.
